newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France puts on 747F relief flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France puts on 747F relief flights.

text.p: Air France said it had operated two round-trip Boeing 747-200F "relief" flights between Paris and London and Paris and Frankfurt in response to the disruption of its trucking network as a result of the lorry drivers dispute.
The flights operated earlier today, and carried a total of 400 tonnes of freight which would have normally been transported by road.

Air France trucking services between France and the UK and France and Germany have been badly affected over the past week because of the road barricades and the only solution was contingency measures of this kind, an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
If the lorry drivers dispute was further prolonged, Air France might have to consider repeating the "relief" flights, the official said.

Earlier this week, Air France had to cancel six out of 14 Boeing 747-200F flights scheduled to operate over a two-day period because of a strike by airline staff. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+544 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
